Free tools

Quick answers for the questions that come up on every lot. They run in your browser. Nothing you type is sent anywhere.

Flip and build deal calculator

Purchase, rehab or build cost, ARV, hold time and financing. Get profit, margin, max offer and a GO, CAUTION or NO-GO with the reason.

Which way does my house face?

Type a bearing, turn a dial or use your phone compass. Get the facing, the backyard direction and a Texas sun note.

Joist and rafter span check

Bending, shear and deflection for 2x lumber at common spacings and loads. Quick reference, not a design.
